title: closePgPool nulls _pool before pool.end() resolves, allowing a racing getPgDb() to recreate the pool
description: closePgPool sets _pool = null and then awaits p.end(); a concurrent getPgDb() during that in-flight await sees _pool === null and creates a fresh Pool, so the just-created pool is never drained and the connections from the closing pool may leak.

title: statement_timeout/query_timeout cannot be disabled because readNumber rejects 0
description: readNumber is called for DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS and DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS without allowZero, so setting either to 0 (pg's documented value to disable the timeout) throws 'Invalid ...' instead of disabling it.
